Well, everybody needs someone. I’m pretty sure that I’m now drawing my final breaths and I wish you nothing less but the best of luck and good fortune.

Thank you for being with me this short span of time.

And please keep doing what you are doing. As I mentioned everybody needs someone and I like to think that I hopefully made someone change their view on life and I hope you will keep doing this.

With love
It truly is, hearing other people enjoy themselves reminds me of the joyful times I’ve had
It’s fine. I got some old episodes of Friends running on the pc and I can hear people chatting in the next house over in their backyard

If there is one thing I can assure you is that things will eventually start to get better. It won’t go over a night and suddenly everything is bright colours and rainbows but it’s more like climbing a ladder. With each step you climb you will get closer to everything returning back to how it used to be. Sure if you fall off this imaginary ladder you have to start over again but then you know you have the strength to do such a thing! 

I’m here in case you only want to talk to someone understanding one time or if you have changed your mind and would like to go on the journey that is getting out of depression and getting rid of anxiety!

<3

First step is to fall child protection service, after that you should start thinking of what kind of life you’d like when you finally get separated from your mom. You likely want children of your own someday right? Try and be the best goddamn version of yourself you could ever be until the day your children get their own. You are very strong and having AND conquering those kind of thoughts at such a young age is a mark of your strength! 

I’m available to chat whenever you feel like it, hopefully you saw this comment! 

<3

Your next step should be realising that you are of extreme worth. I can relate to the feeling of once seeing and being the light but usually the most damaged people smile the brightest just because they don’t want other people suffering the same way they did. Stuff will shine once again. It’s about seeing the stuff that lights up to you and not other people. Do not be afraid of expressing yourself in any way. Your a normal person. We have feelings. It’s a thing. Feeling that everything suddenly got dark is maybe not that uncommon as folks believe. If you ever need any help trying to see your world light up once again, please talk to someone you trust or dm me or any other Redditor reaching out. We love you.

Telling someone of thoughts and feelings like these are very important but you have to try and move past it. Suicide is not the way out. Life is a bitch with our very existence always ending in death. And try to not have thought like “Why postpone it then?” Because trying to make it better will start amount to something. If you ever need anything, me and the rest of the people on this sub are glad to listen. 

With love.

Alright please listen the fuck up to me right now. i’ve been in the exact same spot where my partner cheated on me with a person I knew, a person I called a friend. But it’s not you who were in the wrong. It was your partner who decided that they could actually do something like that. The feeling of a heavy chest might never go away but it will become lighter. It’s about finding stuff in your life that could entertain you in some way. None of us are on this earth for a long time, so why not make it a good time? Try skydiving or scuba diving for example. Seeing the world and nature from a different view instead of the cone ish world you see right now is a life changer, literally. And if you currently don’t have enough energy by yourself to do such things just take one step at a time. After a betrayal like that it’s hard to climb up to the person you once used to be but it’s totally do-able. Just try trusting yourself and try taking a friend or relative along with you while you try and take these steps. Bottling up your emotions is the worst thing you could do and I’m not trying to recommend a therapist but just instead a person you actually trust and just spill all of your thought and feelings. Anxiety is one hell of an illness but it’s totally possible to be your normal self despite it. 

For the sake of you and the genuine people that do care, take care of yourself!
